name: naca0009-preselected-denser-fixed-linkage-slice
preselection: Recorded before further transcription in d2bdb61 and the canonical plan. Frozen five-point data and its failed four-corner result remain unchanged.

source_convention_review.symbols_pdf5: CM is section moment about quarter chord; delta1 relative to airfoil, delta2 relative to forward flap.
source_convention_review.geometry_pdf20: Positive depicted flap deflections are trailing-edge down; c1=.20c, c2=.15c. The slice retains nominal delta2=delta1, both gaps sealed.
source_convention_review.precision_pdf7: Effective-alpha error at zero lift about +/-.3 deg, not a bound over all alpha; each hinge setting +/-.2 deg. Only lift tunnel-corrected; absolute drag corrections unknown.
source_convention_review.conditions_pdf4: 15 psf, about 76 mph, effective Re 2760000, turbulence factor 1.93. No source Mach or temperature established.
source_convention_review.native_cm_vector_sign: Mapped through L-290 reference 7, NACA721 PDF27: positive pitching M is Z toward X. With native FRD axes this is +Y, nose up. For a matched horizontal section about the same quarter-chord point, CM_native = CM_report; no sign flip.
source_convention_review.remaining_mach_gap: L-290 does not establish source Mach or case-linked static thermodynamic state. NACA387's atmospheric differential manometer and generic standard-air example do not provide this 1943 run's absolute pressure/temperature. No Mach is adopted.

reading_allowance_note: New congested-curve manual reading allowances CL +/-.04, CD +/-.003, CM +/-.007. Retained separately from frozen smaller allowances and source/systematic uncertainty; not a physical acceptance tolerance.
